title: Finastra pricing - Mostly custom quote; one product starts at $500,000 flat
clean_text: Finastra does not publish pricing for most of its portfolio; institutions must contact Finastra directly, with terms customized to institution size and scope. The one published data point found is for the Essence core banking product, listed with a starting price of $500,000 as a one-time flat rate. Broader Universal Banking deployments are described industry-wide as multi-year engagements that can cost millions to hundreds of millions of dollars depending on institution size, scope, and deployment approach -- this figure reflects the general core-banking-system-replacement category rather than a Finastra-specific published rate.

meta.source: capterra.com (Finastra Essence listing) + wau.com (industry core-conversion cost context)
